meta.name: add-gcal-tool
meta.description: Add Google Calendar as an MCP tool (list calendars, list/search/create events, free/busy queries) using OneCLI-managed OAuth. Multi-calendar and multi-account supported. Mirrors /add-gmail-tool's stub pattern — no raw credentials ever reach the container; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把谷歌日历变成可调用的工具，自动管理日程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在工作流中直接操作谷歌日历
copy.tagline_en: Turn Google Calendar into a callable tool to manage schedules automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to operate Google Calendar directly in your workflow

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 Google Calendar 工具直接处理你的日历:列出所有日历、查看或搜索事件、创建新事件、查询某时段的空闲/忙碌状态。它使用 OneCLI 管理的登录凭据,你的原始密钥不会进入容器。
howto.when: 当你在对话中提出与日历相关的请求,例如'列出我的日历'、'我下周有什么安排'或'创建一个新事件'时,Claude 会调用这个工具来获取或修改日历数据。

say.note: Claude 会列出你所有的日历。
Claude 会搜索并列出下周一的日程事件。

say.text: 帮我在周五下午三点创建一个会议
say.note: Claude 会在日历中新建该事件。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can work with your Google Calendar via MCP tools: list calendars, view/search events, create new events, and check free/busy slots. It uses OneCLI-managed OAuth; raw credentials never reach the container.
howto.when_en: When you ask something calendar-related, e.g. 'list my calendars', 'what's on my calendar next Monday?', or 'create an event', Claude calls the calendar tool to fetch or modify data.

say_en.note: Claude returns a list of your calendars.

say_en.text: What do I have next Monday?
say_en.note: Claude searches and lists your events for that day.

say_en.text: Create a meeting at 3pm on Friday
say_en.note: Claude adds the event to your calendar.
